dbe_source.recommendation: A trig equation in an interval usually has two solutions. If you wrote one, check whether the second falls in the interval too.

lesson.concept: A trig equation in an interval usually has two solutions. If you wrote one, check whether the second falls in the interval too.
lesson.why: This is one of the most frequent errors DBE reported for this section.

example.problem: Solve for x in [0; 360]: sin x = 0.5
work: Sine is positive in Q1 and Q2.
x = 30 or x = 150. Both in the interval.

probe.problem: Solve for x in [0; 360]: sin x = 0.5.
